title: DailyActivitySummary
description: Source-computed daily activity totals and goals (goals are user-set facts, not derivable from series). One envelope per (person × day × source).

subject.description: @-prefixed eName of the person this data is about

device.description: w3id (@eName) of the measuring device's OWN eVault, where its Device passport lives; null if unknown

provenance.description: Import provenance. Vendor identity lives HERE only (source), never in metric keys.

dedupKey.description: Writer's idempotency key, unique within this ontology on the vault

contentHash.description: Writer-maintained md5 of the payload; recomputed on every rewrite
